name: Blade Waltz
description: Gain the Blade Waltz spell: Become untargetable and dash 8 times around enemy champions, dealing heavy physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: Gain a 100-400 (+6% maximum Health) shield for 5 seconds after immobilizing an enemy champion. Shield stacks continuously with no cooldown.

name: Apex Inventor
description: Gain 300 Item Haste. Reduces cooldowns of all active and passive items (Heartsteel, Eclipse, Sundered Sky, Zhonya's, Luden's) to mere seconds.

name: Jeweled Gauntlet
description: Your active abilities can critically strike. Gain 20% Critical Strike Chance, increased by 1.5% AP. Critical ability damage scales with Crit Damage.

name: Goliath
description: Become gigantic. Gain 35% increased Size, 1000 Maximum Health, and 15% bonus Adaptive Force.

name: Symphony of War
description: Gain both Lethal Tempo and Conqueror keystones simultaneously with no maximum stack limit.

name: Earthwake
description: Your movement abilities and blinks leave behind a trail of rumbling earth that detonates after 1 second for massive physical damage.

name: Omni-Soul
description: Gain 3 random Dragon Souls permanently (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Cloud, Hextech, or Chemtech).

name: Cruelty
description: Immobilizing an enemy calls down a volley of 3 cosmic stars dealing heavy magic damage scaling with AP and Max Health.

name: Eureka
description: Gain Ability Power equal to your total Ability Haste. Spells refund 20% of their cooldown on hit.

name: Accelerating Sorcery
description: Casting an ability grants 10 Ability Haste stacking up to 100 Ability Haste for the remainder of the round.

name: Master of Duality
description: Basic attacks grant stacking Ability Power. Casting abilities grants stacking Attack Damage.

name: Phenomenal Evil
description: Hitting enemies with active abilities permanently grants 1 Ability Power (0.75s per-target cooldown). No upper stack limit.

name: Bread and Butter
description: Your Q ability gains 200 Ability Haste.

name: Scope Attachment
description: Gain 200 Attack Range (100 for Melee champions). Outrange turrets and poke safely from afar.

name: Outlaw's Grit
description: Dashing, leaping, or blinking grants 15 Armor and Magic Resist, stacking up to 5 times (75 total resists).

name: Firebrand
description: Basic attacks apply a burn dealing 2% max health true damage over 5 seconds, stacking infinitely.

name: Magic Missile
description: Dealing active damage to an enemy champion fires 3 homing magic missiles dealing % max health magic damage.

name: Minionmancer
description: Your summons (Tibbers, Maiden, Voidlings, Turrets, Daisy) gain 60% increased size, 50% health, and deal 45% bonus damage.

name: Erosion
description: Damaging an enemy champion reduces their Armor and Magic Resist by 1.5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30% total shred.

name: Vulnerability
description: Your item damage effects (Liandry's, Sunfire, BotRK, Wit's End) and damage over time ticks can critically strike for 150% damage.

name: Witchful Thinking
description: Gain 70 Ability Power immediately.

name: Blunt Force
description: Gain 15% bonus Attack Damage.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 4% of your maximum health.

name: Mind to Matter
description: Gain Maximum Health equal to 50% of your Maximum Mana.
